title: Hearty Kenyan Couscous Pilaf
description: A traditional Kenyan dish with a twist, this pilaf is made with couscous, poached vegetables, and a hint of bitter flavor, served in a mason jar, it is a nostalgic and flexitarian-friendly meal.
instructions: In a large pot, bring the water to a boil and add the couscous, covering the pot with a lid and reducing the heat to low.
Let the couscous cook for 10 minutes, then fluff it with a fork and set it aside.
In a separate pot, bring the vegetable broth to a boil and add the chopped carrots, zucchini, red bell pepper, and onion.
Reduce the heat to medium and let the vegetables poach for 10 minutes, or until they are tender.
Add the minced garlic, chopped bitter melon, salt, and black pepper to the pot with the vegetables and stir to combine.
To assemble the pilaf, add a layer of couscous to the bottom of a mason jar, followed by a layer of the poached vegetables and their broth.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of couscous on top.
Cover the mason jar with a lid and let the pilaf cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the pilaf for at least 30 minutes before serving.
